content.text: High above the mountains, there was a magnificent city made entirely of clouds.
content.translation: 在高山之上，有一座完全由云朵建成的宏伟城市。

content.text: Princess Luna lived there with her family. She had been born on the brightest day of summer.
content.translation: 露娜公主和她的家人住在那里。她出生在夏天最明亮的那一天。

content.text: Every morning, Luna would wake up and paint the sunrise with her magical brush.
content.translation: 每天早晨，露娜都会醒来，用她的魔法画笔描绘日出。

content.text: The people below always wondered why their sunrises were so beautiful. They never knew it was Luna.
content.translation: 下面的人们总是好奇为什么他们的日出如此美丽。他们从不知道那是露娜的杰作。

quiz.question: The city was made entirely of _____.
Luna _____ paint the sunrise every morning.

content.text: In the center of Cloud City stood a magnificent golden palace that had been built centuries ago.
content.translation: 在云端之城的中心，矗立着一座几个世纪前建造的宏伟金色宫殿。

content.text: The palace walls were decorated with precious gems that sparkled like stars at night.
content.translation: 宫殿的墙壁上装饰着珍贵的宝石，在夜晚像星星一样闪烁。

content.text: King Alexander had ruled this kingdom for fifty years. He was known for his wisdom and kindness.
content.translation: 亚历山大国王统治这个王国已经五十年了。他以智慧和善良著称。

content.text: Tomorrow, there will be a grand celebration to honor his long and peaceful reign.
content.translation: 明天将举行盛大庆典，庆祝他长久太平的统治。

quiz.question: The palace had been _____ centuries ago.

content.text: Behind the golden palace, there was a secret garden where magical flowers grew.
content.translation: 在金色宫殿的后面，有一座秘密花园，那里生长着神奇的花朵。

content.text: The gardener had planted these flowers many years ago, and they had been blooming ever since.
content.translation: 园丁多年前种下了这些花，从那以后它们就一直在开放。

content.text: Each flower had a special power. The blue ones could heal wounds, and the golden ones brought happiness.
content.translation: 每朵花都有特殊的力量。蓝色的可以治愈伤口，金色的带来幸福。

content.text: The princess will visit this garden tomorrow to choose flowers for the royal celebration.
content.translation: 公主明天将参观这个花园，为皇家庆典挑选花朵。

quiz.question: The flowers had been _____ ever since.
What could the blue flowers do?

content.text: Legend said that a powerful dragon had protected Cloud City for thousands of years.
content.translation: 传说一条强大的龙已经保护云端之城数千年了。

content.text: The dragon was named Zephyr. He had silver scales and wings as wide as the sky.
content.translation: 这条龙叫泽菲尔。他有银色的鳞片和像天空一样宽阔的翅膀。

content.text: When storms approached the city, Zephyr would fly into the clouds and blow them away.
content.translation: 当暴风雨逼近城市时，西风会飞入云层，把它们吹走。

content.text: The people believed that as long as Zephyr lived, their city would always be safe.
content.translation: 人们相信，只要西风活着，他们的城市就会永远安全。

quiz.question: Zephyr _____ protected Cloud City for thousands of years.

content.text: Long ago, a young prince had disappeared from the golden palace during a terrible storm.
content.translation: 很久以前，在一场可怕的暴风雨中，一位年轻的王子从金色宫殿消失了。

content.text: The king and queen had searched everywhere, but they never found their son.
content.translation: 国王和王后到处寻找，但他们从未找到他们的儿子。

content.text: Many years passed. One day, a young man arrived at the city gates with a familiar golden ring.
content.translation: 多年过去了。有一天，一个年轻人带着一枚熟悉的金戒指来到城门口。

content.text: The queen recognized the ring immediately. Her son had finally returned home!
content.translation: 王后立刻认出了这枚戒指。她的儿子终于回家了！

content.text: In the highest tower of the palace, there was an ancient mirror with mysterious powers.
content.translation: 在宫殿最高的塔楼里，有一面具有神秘力量的古老镜子。

content.text: The mirror had belonged to the first queen, who had used it to see the future.
content.translation: 这面镜子曾属于第一位王后，她曾用它来预见未来。

content.text: Princess Luna had always wanted to look into the mirror, but she was not allowed.
content.translation: 露娜公主一直想照照这面镜子，但大家不让她照。

content.text: Perhaps one day, when she becomes queen, she will finally learn its secrets.
content.translation: 也许有一天，当她成为王后时，她终于会了解它的秘密。

quiz.question: Luna _____ always wanted to look into the mirror.

content.text: Every year, Cloud City held a magnificent festival to celebrate the arrival of summer.
content.translation: 每年，云端之城都会举办盛大的节日来庆祝夏天的到来。

content.text: People had been preparing for this festival for many weeks before it began.
content.translation: 人们在节日开始前已经准备了好几个星期。

content.text: There will be music, dancing, and fireworks that light up the entire sky.
content.translation: 将会有音乐、舞蹈和点亮整个天空的烟花。

content.text: The children are excited because they will receive special gifts from the king.
content.translation: 孩子们很兴奋，因为他们将收到国王的特别礼物。

quiz.question: People had been _____ for many weeks.

content.text: Sir Thomas was the bravest knight in all of Cloud City. He had fought many battles.
content.translation: 托马斯爵士是整个云端之城最勇敢的骑士。他打过许多战役。

content.text: When he was young, he had trained with the greatest warriors of the kingdom.
content.translation: 年轻时，他曾与王国最伟大的战士一起训练。

content.text: Now, he protects the royal family and teaches young soldiers how to fight.
content.translation: 现在，他保护王室家族，并教年轻士兵如何战斗。

content.text: One day, he will pass his golden sword to a worthy successor.
content.translation: 有一天，他将把他的金剑传给一位值得的继承人。

content.text: Every four years, Cloud City holds grand Olympic Games. Athletes from all cloud kingdoms gather to compete.
content.translation: 每四年，云端之城都会举办一届盛大的奥运会。来自所有云端王国的运动员齐聚一堂参加比赛。

content.text: This year, young Sky was going to participate for the first time. He had been training for three years.
content.translation: 今年，年轻的斯凯将首次参加比赛。他已经训练了三年。

content.text: The most exciting event was cloud surfing. Athletes would ride on magical clouds through obstacle courses.
content.translation: 最激动人心的项目是云上冲浪。运动员们骑在魔法云朵上穿越障碍赛道。

content.text: Sky was nervous but determined. "I will do my best," he said. "Whether I win or lose, I will learn from this experience."
content.translation: 斯凯紧张但坚定。"我会尽我所能，"他说。"无论输赢，我都会从这次经历中学习。"

content.text: In the end, Sky finished third. He received a bronze medal and the respect of everyone in Cloud City.
content.translation: 最终，斯凯获得了第三名。他获得了一枚铜牌和云端之城所有人的尊重。

quiz.question: Sky _____ been training for three years.

content.text: Long ago, there lived a wind spirit named Zephyr. She was responsible for bringing gentle breezes to Cloud City.
content.translation: 很久以前，有一个叫泽菲尔的风之精灵。她负责给云端之城带来轻柔的微风。

content.text: One day, Zephyr became very sad. She had lost her best friend, a small cloud named Puff.
content.translation: 有一天，泽菲尔变得非常悲伤。她失去了她最好的朋友，一朵叫帕夫的小云。

content.text: Without her breezes, the clouds stopped moving. The city became very hot and uncomfortable.
content.translation: 没有了她的微风，云朵停止了移动。城市变得非常炎热和不舒适。

content.text: The children of Cloud City decided to help. They made colorful kites and flew them in the sky.
content.translation: 云端之城的孩子们决定帮忙。他们制作了五颜六色的风筝，在天空中放飞。

content.text: When Zephyr saw the beautiful kites, she smiled. "These children have given me a new reason to blow," she said.
content.translation: 当泽菲尔看到美丽的风筝时，她笑了。"这些孩子给了我一个新的理由去吹风，"她说。

content.text: From that day on, the wind spirit always blows gently when children fly their kites.
content.translation: 从那天起，每当孩子们放风筝时，风之精灵总是轻轻地吹着风。

quiz.question: What did the children make to help Zephyr?

content.text: Welcome to Cloud City! Before you can explore, you must answer some questions about the clouds.
content.translation: 欢迎来到云端之城！在你探索之前，你必须回答一些关于云的问题。

content.text: Clouds are made of tiny water droplets. They float high in the sky because they are very light.
content.translation: 云是由微小的水滴组成的。它们漂浮在高空因为它们非常轻。

quiz.question: Clouds are made of tiny water _____.
Clouds float because they are very _____.

content.text: At the highest tower of Cloud City lives the Cloud Guardian, a majestic dragon made entirely of mist.
content.translation: 在云端之城最高的塔楼上住着云端守护者，一条完全由雾气组成的威严巨龙。

content.text: The dragon had watched over Cloud City since the beginning of time. Its scales shimmer like silver.
content.translation: 这条龙从天地初开时就守护着云端之城。它的鳞片闪耀如银。

content.text: "Young traveler," the dragon speaks, "you have traveled far and learned much about time and change."
content.translation: "年轻的旅行者，"巨龙说道，"你已经走了很远，学到了很多关于时间和变化的知识。"

content.text: "The past has shaped you, and the future awaits. Now you are ready for the eternal stars."
content.translation: "过去塑造了你，未来在等待。现在你已准备好迎接永恒的星辰。"

content.text: "Go to the Realm of Eternal Starlight. May the winds always carry you safely!"
content.translation: "去永恒星光之境吧。愿风永远安全地带着你！"

quiz.question: The dragon _____ watched over Cloud City since the beginning.

content.text: The Sky Challenge had been the most difficult test in Cloud City for hundreds of years.
content.translation: 几百年来，天空挑战一直是云端之城最困难的测试。

content.text: Only those who had mastered the language of the wind could pass. Many had tried, but few had succeeded.
content.translation: 只有掌握了风之语言的人才能通过。许多人尝试过，但很少有人成功。

content.text: If you complete this challenge, you will have proven yourself worthy of the Cloud Kingdom.
content.translation: 如果你完成这个挑战，你将证明自己配得上云之王国。

quiz.question: The Sky Challenge _____ been the most difficult test.
Many had tried, but few had _____.
